Subject: Neighborhood Plant Pot Swap 🌱

Hi neighbors,

Have a few spare plant pots gathering dust? Let’s get together to swap pots, chat about our plants, and meet some friendly faces!

Join us at [location] on [date] at [time]. Bring any pots you’d like to pass along, or simply come and browse. You’re very welcome even if you have nothing to bring—there’s no need to contribute to take something home.

Hope to see you there!

Warmly,
[Your name]
